source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The X-SHOWDETAILS branch calls the selected calendar window through an optional chain and returns true immediately. Its viewing wrapper returns no completion promise, and the new-dialog receiver may import the component asynchronously before showing it. The message-bar caller forwards the Boolean, so it is not proof that a dialog opened; an absent owner window also leaves the true return unchanged. The changed browser task instead waits for #calendarDialog[open] after clicking Details. This is a static caller/completion boundary. No dialog, missing-window scenario or browser test was executed.
title: iTIP Details returns before the read dialog finishes opening
